candidate.title: CEL-Seq
candidate.scope: The original CEL-Seq schematic: three individually indexed single-cell RNA branches converge at pooling, followed by library construction, PCR and cell-index-based sequence assignment. The leftmost titled cell/RNA vignette is an overview icon, not an additional input branch. Similar methods and unshown adaptations are outside scope. Primary-supported clarifications of the drawing are identified explicitly.
